Shoshana Weissmann, Sloth Committee Chair 🦥 (@senatorshoshana)

Wait can you explain this is such a far fetched idea



— https://nitter.net/senatorshoshana/status/2057427690194710961#m

“Good morning. It’s Thursday. The hot weather went away! So we went on a long walk today. We went to two new dog parks. I don’t trust them yet. Impossible to know where the mean dogs are. But Zoë likes it. Also thumb guy thought we were out of treats this morning and then he found a chicken leg! So we’re good. Also, I love you.”

Imagine if Congress had any self-respect. I mean just a little.


The Washington Post (@washingtonpost)

Breaking news: The Trump administration does not plan to seek approval from Congress for President Trump’s planned 250-foot arch, arguing that they do not need it because lawmakers a century ago authorized a somewhat similar project that was never built. wapo.st/4dD92xG




— https://nitter.net/washingtonpost/status/2057205990408204799#m

And….?


Connor O’Brien (@cojobrien)

This is literally illegal to build under federal law in Washington DC.



— https://nitter.net/cojobrien/status/2057149365970452519#m

Whoa. China now using yen as their currency.


Cointelegraph (@Cointelegraph)

🇨🇳 NEW: Chinese cities are rolling out AI-powered robot barber kiosks that scan customers in 3D and cut hair with millimeter precision for just 60 yen per session.

— https://nitter.net/Cointelegraph/status/2057179551344611792#m

And a star on her nose.


WeRateDogs (@dog_rates)

We really wanted to introduce you to Vanilla. She has the daintiest handshake we've ever witnessed. 14/10

Video

“Good morning. It’s Friday. Don’t be frightened by my collar. It’s for scaring away mean dogs. At least that’s what they told me. Also, I love you.”

Giving this a whirl. This is my first Bluesky post and, yes, I'm tweeting pictures of my dogs. Don't say you weren't warned.
